description: Fullstack feature development with frontend/backend agents coordinated by orchestrator

tasks.description: Implement a user profile feature: Backend needs a GET /api/users/:id endpoint returning {id, name, email, avatar}. Frontend needs a ProfileCard component that fetches and displays this data with loading and error states.

Add search functionality: Backend needs a GET /api/search?q=term endpoint with pagination. Frontend needs a SearchBar component with debounced input and a SearchResults component showing paginated results.

Build a notification system: Backend needs endpoints for creating, listing, and marking notifications as read. Frontend needs a NotificationBell component with a dropdown showing unread count and recent notifications.
